replacement.name: Ri Kynjai - Serenity By The Lake
replacement.tagline: Khasi-thatch upturned-boat roofs across 45 acres above Umiam Lake — Centre Point Group's signature boutique resort, the only Shillong stay with a true 'serenity' setting away from Police Bazar.
replacement.address: Umniuh Khwan, Umbir, Ri-Bhoi District 793122, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Hotel Polo Towers Shillong
replacement.tagline: Opposite the Polo Grounds, two minutes from Police Bazar — Sky Grill rooftop, ranked #2 of 70 Shillong hotels, the easiest walking-distance base for Bara Bazar and Don Bosco Museum.
replacement.address: Oakland Road, Police Bazar, Shillong 793001, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Courtyard by Marriott Shillong
replacement.tagline: Marriott's modern Shillong outpost on the M.G. Road / Polo cluster — full spa, masala-tea afternoons, the most consistent international-standard rooms in town.
replacement.address: M.G. Road, Police Bazar, Shillong 793001, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Polo Orchid Resort Cherrapunji
replacement.tagline: Infinity pool angled at the Seven Sisters Falls, Khliehshnong cliff-edge — the only resort in Sohra with this view and the closest you can sleep to the Mawsmai falls.
replacement.address: Near Seven Sisters Falls, Mawsmai-Nongthymmai Road, Sohra (Cherrapunji) 793108, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Cherrapunjee Holiday Resort
replacement.tagline: Hilltop in Laitkynsew village with Bangladesh plains views — Khasi-women-run hospitality and the trekking-launch base for the Nongriat double-decker root bridge descent.
replacement.address: Laitkynsew Village, Sohra (Cherrapunji), East Khasi Hills 793111, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Goshen Homestay
replacement.tagline: Family-run Khasi homestay in Sohra — vibrant garden, complimentary home-cooked breakfast, the cleanest budget bed in Cherrapunji town for waterfall and root-bridge day trips.

replacement.name: Kynjai Homestay, Mawlynnong
replacement.tagline: Inside Asia's cleanest village — neat rooms with mosquito nets, terrace, double beds for four; the most reliable in-village stay, cash-only, hosted on a single Khasi family plot.
replacement.address: Mawlynnong Village, East Khasi Hills 793109, Meghalaya

replacement.name: By The River Homestay
replacement.tagline: Stand-alone house with a seasonal stream behind it at the entrance of Mawlynnong — hosted by Livingstone Sangma, his wife Orilin Joel and son Benjamin, ten minutes from the Riwai single-decker root bridge.
replacement.address: Mawlynnong Village, East Khasi Hills 793109, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Mawlynnong Homestay (Paiñ)
replacement.tagline: Three-room community homestay (1 Classic, 1 Family, 1 traditional Bamboo Hut) in the cleanest village in Asia — village-walk, bird-watching and bonfire built into the price.
replacement.address: Mawlynnong Village, East Khasi Hills 793109, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Maple Pine Farm
replacement.tagline: Off-grid solar/wind-powered four-cottage farm at the foot of the Mawphlang Sacred Forest — hosted by Khasi-Canadian couple Valariena Perry Syiemlieh and James Murray Perry, half-hour walk to the grove.
replacement.address: Lyngkien Village, near Mawphlang Sacred Forest, East Khasi Hills 793121, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Lyngdoh Mawphlang Homestay
replacement.tagline: Khasi family homestay run by the Lyngdoh clan (caretakers of the Mawphlang Sacred Grove) — the most authentic 'sacred-grove' base, simple rooms, home-cooked Khasi meals.
replacement.address: Mawphlang Village, East Khasi Hills 793121, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Emily And Sankrita Homestay
replacement.tagline: Family homestay in Mawsynram village proper — clean rooms with kettles and towels, knowledgeable host who guides Mawjymbuin Cave visits, the only verifiable in-village stay in the wettest place on earth.
replacement.address: Mawsynram Village, East Khasi Hills 793113, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Serene Homestay
replacement.tagline: Two minutes from the Umshiang Double-Decker Living Root Bridge — Byron and family started Nongriat tourism, mostly dormitory beds plus two doubles, reachable only via the 3,500-step descent from Tyrna.
replacement.address: Nongriat Village, Sohra (Cherrapunji), East Khasi Hills 793108, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Pioneer Adventure Camp Shnongpdeng
replacement.tagline: Riverside tents on the Umngot beach — co-founder Jason runs scuba, kayaking, cliff-jumping and zip-lining on the clearest river in India, water visibility ~35 ft.
replacement.address: Shnongpdeng Village, West Jaintia Hills 793109, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Marvel's Camps Riverside Shnongpdeng
replacement.tagline: Tent-and-cottage operator on the Umngot riverbank with the Betelnut Resort tie-up at Dawki — bonfire and overnight river-camp packages, the second-most-established Shnongpdeng outfit.
replacement.address: Shnongpdeng Village, West Jaintia Hills 793109, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Hotel Polo Orchid Tura
replacement.tagline: The only luxury hotel in West Garo Hills — Polo Group's Tura outpost with spacious rooms, complimentary breakfast, the gateway base for Nokrek Biosphere and Siju Caves.
replacement.address: Hawakhana, Tura, West Garo Hills 794101, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Hotel Rikman Continental
replacement.tagline: 35 rooms in the heart of Tura town adjacent to Tura Super Market and the State Transport bus stand — Garo Hills' most centrally placed and reliably serviced hotel.
replacement.address: Tura Bazar, Tura, West Garo Hills 794001, Meghalaya

replacement.name: Tree House Tura
replacement.tagline: 5,00,000 sq-ft greenfield property at the edge of Tura — Garo ethnic-modern cottages, the most distinctive non-luxury option in the West Garo Hills.
